name: Racing & Emotion
note: Le Mans-based design studio making motorsport-inspired collectible furniture; Genesis Magma Racing named it an Official Licensing Partner (2026-06-03) and calls Benoit Fraylon its founder. France's official register (RNE) shows JANNARELLY & FRAYLON DESIGN (RACING ET EMOTION), SIREN 529 872 103, as closed since 2016, and an active self-employed registration for Benoit Fraylon (artistic creation, SIREN 488 733 205). The legal entity behind the current brand could not be verified, so the owner is not recorded here.
